# CR-9208: Acme Manufacturing credit limit increase to $650,000

**Yes, with authorization.** Acme Manufacturing is eligible for $650,000. Michael Torres has no credit-approval authority, so the increase needs **Elena Novak (Director of Finance)** to approve it. It also needs **David Morgan (Chief Revenue Officer)** to concur. The VP Sales concurrence passes to him because Michael Torres is the VP Sales and submitted the request.

## 1. The request
- **Request:** CR-9208, from Michael Torres (VP Sales), dated 2026-09-23.
- **Customer:** ERP C-1001.
- **Change:** raise the limit from $250,000 to $650,000.
- **Status:** Pending Approval in Northstar ERP. The submitted figures match the system of record.
- **Basis:** the customer's own standing. The justification is the third-plant ramp-up and does not rely on the guarantee.

## 2. The customer
ERP "Acme Mfg. Holdings" (C-1001) and CRM "Acme Manufacturing" (CRM-2048) are the same company. Both records show:
- DUNS 04-812-7730
- 2200 N Industrial Pkwy, Milwaukee, WI

The guarantee also names this company, doing business as Acme Manufacturing. Northstar CRM records the account tier as **Strategic**.

## 3. The policy
CREDIT-POLICY-2026 applies, because it is in force from 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

## 4. Payment history
The rule is that no invoice due in the 12 months before the request (2025-09-23 to 2026-09-23) may be paid, or unpaid, more than 30 days after its due date.

| Invoice | Due date | Paid | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-60412 | 2025-11-28 | 2025-11-24 | On time |
| INV-62011 | 2026-07-25 | 2026-07-22 | On time |
| INV-62305 | 2026-10-02 | Unpaid | Not yet due on the request date |

Payment history passes.

## 5. Maximum limit
The Strategic maximum is **$750,000**, and $650,000 is within it. GRT-ACME-2026 covers this customer and is in force. It would raise the maximum by $400,000 to $1,150,000, but it isn't needed for this request.

## 6. The requestor's authority
The policy gives the VP Sales no approval authority. Michael Torres cannot approve this alone.

## 7. Required approvers
- **Approval:** limits over $500,000 need the Director of Finance, who is **Elena Novak**.
- **Concurrence:** Strategic accounts over $500,000 also need VP Sales concurrence. The VP Sales is Michael Torres, the requestor. He cannot concur on his own request, so it passes to his manager, **David Morgan**.

## 8. Points worth noting (not blocking)
- INV-62305 ($720,000) fell due on 2026-10-02 and is still unpaid as of today, 2026-10-08. It is 6 days overdue, well short of the 30-day threshold.
- That open balance is above both the current $250,000 limit and the requested $650,000.

```json
{
  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "CR-9208", "customer": "Acme Mfg. Holdings (dba Acme Manufacturing), ERP C-1001 / CRM-2048", "current_limit": 250000, "requested_limit": 650000,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Michael Torres (VP Sales, EMP-200)", "basis": "standard"},
  "eligibility": {"status": "eligible", "maximum_limit": 750000,
                  "basis": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026 Strategic tier maximum $750,000 (tier per Northstar CRM); payment history clean under 30-day rule. GRT-ACME-2026 ($400,000, covers C-1001, in force) not needed.", "late_invoices": []},
  "authority": {"policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Director of Finance, with VP Sales concurrence (Strategic account over $500,000)",
                "approvers": [{"name": "Elena Novak", "role": "Director of Finance", "kind": "approval"},
                              {"name": "David Morgan", "role": "Chief Revenue Officer (requestor's manager, in place of VP Sales, who is the requestor)", "kind": "concurrence"}]},
  "evidence": ["structured/credit_requests.csv CR-9208", "structured/customers.csv C-1001", "structured/crm_accounts.csv CRM-2048 (Strategic, DUNS 04-812-7730)", "structured/erp_credit.csv C-1001", "structured/erp_invoices.csv INV-60412, INV-62011, INV-62305", "structured/employees.csv", "CREDIT-POLICY-2026 (OWM register)", "GRT-ACME-2026 (OWM register)"],
  "missing_evidence": [],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "INV-62305 ($720,000, due 2026-10-02) is unpaid and 6 days past due as of 2026-10-08; not late under the 30-day rule on the request date, but monitor collection", "who": "Accounts Receivable (Robert Hernandez)", "blocking": false},
    {"what": "Open balance of INV-62305 ($720,000) exceeds both the current $250,000 limit and the requested $650,000 limit", "who": "Finance (Elena Novak)", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
